title: Mumbai resident doctors threaten ‘bheekh maango andolan’ over recurring delays in stipend payments

ai.summary: Mumbai resident doctors threaten a 'bheekh maango andolan' protest due to recurring delays in monthly stipend payments, which affect their financial planning and loan repayments.

facts.claim: Mumbai resident doctors threaten to launch a protest called 'bheekh maango andolan' over recurring delays in the disbursal of their monthly stipends
facts.quote: Resident doctors at Mumbai’s Cooper Hospital say recurring stipend delays affect EMIs and financial planning, and threaten a ‘bheekh maango andolan’.

facts.claim: Resident doctors receive stipends of over ₹90,000 from medical colleges
facts.quote: Resident doctors in Mumbai receive stipends of over ₹90,000 from the medical colleges in lieu of the services rendered.

facts.claim: Stipends are delayed due to clerical staff being diverted to Special Intensive Revision (SIR) work
facts.quote: The residents were told that their stipends were delayed because the clerical staff had been diverted to duty on the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) work.

ai.background_note: Mumbai resident doctors are part of the broader movement against delays in stipend payments for medical residents, which has been reported in multiple BMC medical colleges.
